checksums.name: slot_sum8_seeded
checksums.formula_detail: u32 accumulator seeded with literal-pool word _DAT_08011b98 (value NOT present in workspace), then adds each byte of slot[0..27] with u32 wraparound; compared against stored u32_le. Decompiled proof: FUN_08011794 at ghidra/decompiled.c:1145-1149.

checksums.name: global_sum8_seeded
checksums.formula_detail: Same shape as slot checksum: seed _DAT_0800a730 (value NOT present in workspace) plus sum of global-block bytes [0..307] relative to block start (file 96..403); stored u32_le at file offset 404 (RAM base+0x1E4). Decompiled proof: FUN_0800a328 at ghidra/decompiled.c:620-625.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 engine: writes src/dst/count|0x80000000 to three literal-pool pointers (inferred DMA3 SAD 0x040000D4 / DAD 0x040000D8 / CNT 0x040000DC per packet hardware spec), then polls CNT busy bit. Used for both EEPROM bitstream phases; role listed as write because it programs DMA in both directions.
EEPROM read one 8-byte block: builds MSB-first address bitstream with two leading 1 bits, DMA to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 units), DMA back 0x44 halfwords, unpacks 64 bits into u16s at ram+6,+4,+2,+0.

EEPROM bulk read: loops func_0x0802dc38 over (byte_len>>3) 8-byte blocks after func_0x0802da4c(4) bus setup. Callers mapped by address equality of func_0x0802b9ac call sites (callgraph.json drops func_ edges).
Slot load+validate+unpack; also computes the slot checksum inline (no separate checksum function). Zeroes fields and retries x3 on mismatch.
Global block load+validate (312 bytes at EEPROM block 12); checksum inline; no field unpacking in this function.
RAM defaults/reset for the same fields the slot unpacker writes (sets +0x0C lanes to 4 and 0x17, zeroes counters). Does not touch EEPROM; not a writer.

open_questions: Checksum seed values _DAT_08011b98 (slots) and _DAT_0800a730 (global) are literal-pool words whose values appear nowhere in the workspace; with seed 0 the sample slot 0 computes 0x000001FC vs stored 0x00000000. Is the true slot seed 0xFFFFFE04, is this snapshot pre-first-flush/invalid, or is the stored word at +0x1C written by a different (untraced) rule?

No EEPROM write/serialize function exists among the 237 traced functions. Are func_0x0800cdec / func_0x08006d74 (called with base+slot at decompiled.c:2283-2284) the serializer+flush, and what EEPROM write-bitstream routine do they use?
What are the semantics of the 9-byte blob at slot offset 7 (only its first byte is proven as an occupancy flag) and of the two u32 fields at 0x10/0x14?
Bytes 0x18..0x1B (0x71CD5B07) are consumed only through two narrow masks (0xF / 0x1F). Is there a wider field (counter, play time, RNG state) that the untraced serializer maintains?
Global block (312 bytes at 0x60) field semantics: no consumer offsets were traced beyond the checksum reader.
Exact DMA3 register addresses for FUN_0802dbb8's literal-pool pointers (inferred 0x040000D4/D8/DC from hardware spec, not resolved in corpus), and the register written by func_0x0802da4c(4).

Does the emulator .sav byte order within each 8-byte EEPROM block match the RAM buffer order? sum8 is permutation-invariant so the checksum cannot decide this; a known-answer field test (fuzzing target at offset 0) can.
